assessments.reasoning: The Go Authors' go1.23.0 tag resolves to 6885bad7dd86880be6929c02085e5c7a67ff2887. This exact publisher resource is the specification labelled language version go1.23. The fresh full-response digest equals the registered source revision's digest. The range-expression clause requires a function with a listed signature and the edition table marks function range as a Go 1.23 feature. The outer function takes the yield callback and returns no values. The callback's boolean result is distinct from an outer function result. The range expression has one of the listed function core types and satisfies the other requirements of a range clause. The callback arity determines the available iteration values. This does not permit functions with arbitrary arguments or result values. A callback can deliver zero, one or two iteration values as listed. An outer iterator function returning a boolean is not one of these signatures.
